questions.prompt: count is 0 in this render. A handler calls setCount(count + 1) three times. What count is queued?

choices.text: 0, because direct replacement updates are ignored in handlers.
3, because each call mutates the captured count immediately.
2, because React removes only one duplicate queued update.
1, because all three calls use the same captured value.

questions.explanation: Each expression reads 0 and requests replacement with 1. The render snapshot does not change between calls.

questions.explanation: A handler and its timeout capture that render snapshot. Setting state does not rewrite an already created closure.

React batches every event during the entire lifetime of the page.
Browser painting is the only operation that updates React state.
React does not batch separate intentional events into one event.
